propositions: True escaped-defect rate and detection-stage efficiency cannot be calculated from current data because only 7 of 648 bugs have detected_by metadata populated (1.1% coverage) and caused_by links are advisory and demonstrably noisy
Plan-review first-pass rate is 49.0% with p90 attempts of 8, consuming 114.7 LLM calls per completed PASS; deterministic preflight checks could reduce churn and operationalize semantic review

Code-review first-pass is 97.4% and completion first-pass is 72.3%, but completion non-PASS reasons are not machine-classified, preventing root-cause triage of code defect versus environment versus verifier errors

Commit process governance (ticket trailer, DCO, Change-Id) reached ~100% adoption by late Q3; source diffs decreased (median 95 lines, 11.0% above 400) while test co-change increased (median 160.5 lines on source changes), supporting process maturation

35 source modules are at or above 720 LOC (15 at or above 780 LOC including inbound_differ.py, binding_store.py, apply_inbound_records.py, signing.py, llm/runner.py), and 4.09% duplication exists; same-file retouch within 24h occurs in 47.7% of consecutive pairs, signaling debt and coordination pressure

Risk-tiered review and prospective risk scoring from initial plan non-PASS, file breadth, and hotspot intersections are candidate interventions but lack prospectively validated outcome models; causality cannot be established from 68-day window with concurrent process maturation
